name: glm-conductor
description: Selective routing orchestration for GLM coding agents on ZCode Native Workflows. The GLM-5.3 main session stays the single architect: it declares solo/delegate/audit/full routes on two axes (Delegability x Assurance), compiles delegated work from a canonical static DAG into a ZCode Native Workflow, and owns task-level validation and acceptance. Minimal deterministic guarantees are built in - task-level change_id freshness, ownership scope, a one-active-write-Workflow-per-repo writer guard, and a four-check Stop-hook completion guard - plus optional user-authorized bounded quota resume (waiting_quota with native Scheduled Task wake). Fresh-context read-only reviewers (glm-reviewer / visual-reviewer) cover high-assurance routes; visual-implementer remains the multimodal exception.
